* cge-stata: ado/cge_gams_model.txt, the files below in sections that begin with @@@ (written by tools/bundle_files.py; do not edit)
@@@ cge_model.gms
$title cge-stata model in GAMS: an independent check of docs/model_spec.md
$ontext
Independent implementation of the static model of docs/model_spec.md
(Sections 5 to 7), written from the specification rather than from the Stata
or Python code. It calibrates from the SAM in the include file %data%, which
is in the standard layout (after the layout rewrites of Section 7.0), solves
the base, writes the base solution to %out%, and can save a work file from
which a scenario is solved.

The model is solved as a constrained nonlinear system (CNS, with PATH by
default); with --cgetype=nlp, as a nonlinear programme with a constant
objective, for NLP solvers such as CONOPT or IPOPT; or, with --cgetype=mcp,
as a mixed complementarity problem, which constraints need (from version
0.4.4, model_spec.md, Section 16). --cgesolver names the solver (path by
default).

Used in two ways:
- by tools/gams/run_gams_check.py, the package's independent check, for example
    gams cge_model.gms --data=data.inc --out=base.csv s=work
- by cge_gams (from version 0.4.3), which writes the data of a model in
  Stata and a driver, cge_run.gms, that includes this file
$offtext

$if not set data $abort "set --data=<include file>"
$if not set out $set out base.csv
$if not set cgesolver $set cgesolver path
$if not set cgetype $set cgetype cns

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Data: sets of accounts by role, the SAM and the model settings
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
$onempty
$include "%data%"
$offempty

alias (AC, ACP), (C, CP), (F, FP), (A, AP);
* Margin accounts (13.4): T per unit of composite supply, TD of domestic sales,
* TIM of imports, TEX of exports
set TALL(AC) "all margin accounts";
TALL(T) = yes;  TALL(TD) = yes;  TALL(TIM) = yes;  TALL(TEX) = yes;
set D(AC) "households and enterprises";
D(H) = yes;
D(E) = yes;
alias (D, DP);
set INS(AC) "institutions receiving factor income";
INS(D) = yes;
INS(GOVS) = yes;
INS(ROWS) = yes;
INS(SHIS) = yes;

scalar tol "tolerance for structural zeros";
tol = 1e-9 * max(1, smax((AC, ACP), abs(SAM(AC, ACP))));
scalar fund "1 when a health insurance fund is mapped";
fund = 1$(card(SHIS) > 0);

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* 7.2 Taxes and trade
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
sets CM(AC) "imported", CX(AC) "with domestic output", CR(AC) "exports from composite supply",
     CE(AC) "exports from domestic output", CT(AC) "margin services",
     CDO(AC) "with domestic sales", CQ(AC) "with composite supply", CED(AC) "finite export demand";
parameters QM0(AC), tm(AC), exports(AC), etax(AC), QA0(AC), ta(AC), theta(AC, AC), QX0(AC),
     te(AC), QE0(AC), QER0(AC), pwe(AC), pwm(AC), QD0(AC), PM0(AC), stax(AC), MG(AC), QQ0(AC), tq(AC),
     QT0(AC), spend(AC), icm(AC, AC), qerbar(AC), QAM0(AC), EM(AC), DM(AC), IMG(AC),
     icd(AC, AC), ici(AC, AC), ice(AC, AC), PDD0(AC), qebar(AC);
QM0(C) = sum(ROWS, SAM(ROWS, C));
CM(C) = yes$(QM0(C) > tol);
tm(C)$CM(C) = sum(MTAXS, SAM(MTAXS, C)) / QM0(C);
exports(C) = sum(ROWS, SAM(C, ROWS));
etax(C) = sum(ETAXS, SAM(ETAXS, C));
QA0(A) = sum(AC, SAM(AC, A));
ta(A) = sum(ATAXS, SAM(ATAXS, A)) / QA0(A);
* Home consumption (13.1): yields per unit of marketed output
QAM0(A) = QA0(A) - sum(H, SAM(A, H));
theta(A, C) = SAM(A, C) / QAM0(A);
QX0(C) = sum(A, SAM(A, C));
CX(C) = yes$(QX0(C) > tol);
* Export-only commodities XO (13.3) are chosen by the user
CR(C) = yes$(exports(C) > tol and QX0(C) - (exports(C) - etax(C)) <= tol and not XO(C));
CE(C) = yes$(exports(C) > tol and not CR(C));
EM(C) = sum(TEX, SAM(TEX, C));
DM(C) = sum(TD, SAM(TD, C));
IMG(C) = sum(TIM, SAM(TIM, C));
te(C)$CE(C) = etax(C) / exports(C);
QE0(C)$CE(C) = exports(C) - etax(C) - EM(C);
abort$(sum(C$(XO(C) and abs(QE0(C) - QX0(C)) > tol), 1)) "export-only commodity whose exports differ from its output";
QER0(C)$CR(C) = exports(C);
qerbar(C) = QER0(C);
pwe(C) = 1 / (1 - te(C));
pwe(C)$CE(C) = exports(C) / QE0(C);
pwm(C) = 1;
CDO(C) = yes$(CX(C) and not XO(C));
QD0(C)$CDO(C) = QX0(C) - QE0(C);
spend(TALL) = sum(C, SAM(C, TALL));
icd(CP, C)$CDO(C) = sum(TD$(spend(TD) > tol), SAM(CP, TD) / spend(TD) * SAM(TD, C)) / QD0(C);
ici(CP, C)$CM(C) = sum(TIM$(spend(TIM) > tol), SAM(CP, TIM) / spend(TIM) * SAM(TIM, C)) / QM0(C);
ice(CP, C)$CE(C) = sum(TEX$(spend(TEX) > tol), SAM(CP, TEX) / spend(TEX) * SAM(TEX, C)) / QE0(C);
PM0(C)$CM(C) = 1 + tm(C) + sum(CP, ici(CP, C));
PDD0(C) = 1 + sum(CP, icd(CP, C));
stax(C) = sum(STAXS, SAM(STAXS, C));
MG(C) = sum(T, SAM(T, C));
QQ0(C) = PDD0(C) * QD0(C) + PM0(C) * QM0(C) + stax(C) + MG(C);
CQ(C) = yes$(CDO(C) or CM(C));
tq(C)$CQ(C) = stax(C) / QQ0(C);
QT0(C) = sum(TALL, SAM(C, TALL));
CT(C) = yes$(QT0(C) > tol);
icm(CP, C)$CQ(C) = sum(T$(spend(T) > tol), SAM(CP, T) / spend(T) * SAM(T, C)) / QQ0(C);
* Export demand (13.2): elasticities given by the user
CED(C) = yes$(etae(C) > 0 and CE(C));
qebar(C) = QE0(C);

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* 12.2 VAT: each use of a commodity is a quantity at PQ = 1, its SAM value
* divided by 1 + tv k, with k = 1 for final users and 1 - kappa for
* activities. tv solves SAM(vat, c) = sum of V tv k / (1 + tv k) (Newton).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
parameters kappa(AC) "VAT credit share", vatc(AC) "net VAT by commodity", tv(AC) "VAT rate",
     vbase(AC), vf(AC), vdf(AC), vstep(AC), qhv(AC, AC);
kappa(A) = kappain(A);
vatc(C) = sum(VTAXS, SAM(VTAXS, C));
vbase(C) = sum(A, SAM(C, A) * (1 - kappa(A))) + sum(H, SAM(C, H)) + sum(GOVS, SAM(C, GOVS))
           + sum(SAVS, SAM(C, SAVS)) + sum(SHIS, SAM(C, SHIS));
tv(C)$(abs(vatc(C)) > tol) = vatc(C) / vbase(C);
scalar it;
for (it = 1 to 60,
    vf(C)$tv(C) = sum(A, SAM(C, A) * tv(C) * (1 - kappa(A)) / (1 + tv(C) * (1 - kappa(A))))
                  + (sum(H, SAM(C, H)) + sum(GOVS, SAM(C, GOVS)) + sum(SAVS, SAM(C, SAVS))
                     + sum(SHIS, SAM(C, SHIS))) * tv(C) / (1 + tv(C)) - vatc(C);
    vdf(C)$tv(C) = sum(A, SAM(C, A) * (1 - kappa(A)) / sqr(1 + tv(C) * (1 - kappa(A))))
                   + (sum(H, SAM(C, H)) + sum(GOVS, SAM(C, GOVS)) + sum(SAVS, SAM(C, SAVS))
                      + sum(SHIS, SAM(C, SHIS))) / sqr(1 + tv(C));
    vstep(C)$tv(C) = vf(C) / vdf(C);
    tv(C)$tv(C) = tv(C) - vstep(C);
);
abort$(smax(C, abs(vstep(C))) > 1e-13) "VAT rates did not converge";

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* 7.3 Production. Factor quantities may be supplied (fqin, from version
* 0.4.3); otherwise they are the factor payments, and W0 = WFDIST0 = 1
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
sets FA(AC, AC) "factor used by activity", CDV(AC) "Cobb-Douglas value added",
     LT(AC) "Leontief top nest", CDA(AC) "Cobb-Douglas top nest";
parameters QINTA0(AC), ica(AC, AC), QF0(AC, AC), QVA0(AC), iva(AC), inta(AC), rva(AC), dva(AC, AC),
     ad(AC), PINTA0(AC), rha(AC), ratioa(AC), dla(AC), dlac(AC), aa(AC), valuea(AC),
     W0(AC) "base wage", WFD0(AC, AC) "base wage distortion";
parameter QINT0(AC, AC) "intermediate input quantities";
QINT0(C, A) = SAM(C, A) / (1 + tv(C) * (1 - kappa(A)));
* 17.2 Nests of value added (from version 0.5.1): nests NST with members NSTF,
* factors and commodities, and elasticities signest. Commodities in a nest
* leave intermediate input (NE) for value added
sets NE(AC, AC) "commodity in a nest bought by an activity", QIX(AC, AC) "intermediate input flows",
     NFREE(AC) "factors in no nest", NNA(NST, AC) "nest used by an activity", CDN(NST) "Cobb-Douglas nests";
alias (NST, NSTP);
NE(C, A) = yes$(sum(NST$NSTF(NST, C), 1) and QINT0(C, A) <> 0);
QINTA0(A) = sum(C$(not NE(C, A)), QINT0(C, A));
ica(C, A)$(QINTA0(A) > 0 and not NE(C, A)) = QINT0(C, A) / QINTA0(A);
QIX(C, A) = yes$(ica(C, A) or NE(C, A));
FA(F, A) = yes$(SAM(F, A) > tol);
QF0(F, A)$FA(F, A) = SAM(F, A);
QF0(F, A)$(fqgiven and FA(F, A)) = fqin(F, A);
abort$(fqgiven and sum((F, A)$(FA(F, A) and fqin(F, A) <= 0), 1)) "factor quantities must be positive where factor payments are";
W0(F) = 1;
W0(F)$fqgiven = sum(A, SAM(F, A)) / sum(A, QF0(F, A));
WFD0(F, A) = 1;
WFD0(F, A)$(fqgiven and FA(F, A)) = SAM(F, A) / (W0(F) * QF0(F, A));
* 17.1 Taxes on factor use (from version 0.5.0): accounts FTAXS, each taxing
* the factor given in ftfac; rates on factor payments; value added at factor
* cost includes them
parameters TFA0(AC, AC) "taxes on factor use", tf(AC, AC) "tax rate on factor use";
TFA0(F, A) = sum(FTAXS$ftfac(FTAXS, F), SAM(FTAXS, A));
abort$(sum((F, A)$(not FA(F, A) and abs(TFA0(F, A)) > tol), 1)) "a tax on factor use where the factor is not used";
tf(F, A)$FA(F, A) = TFA0(F, A) / SAM(F, A);
QVA0(A) = sum(F, SAM(F, A) + TFA0(F, A)) + sum(C$NE(C, A), SAM(C, A));
iva(A) = QVA0(A) / QA0(A);
inta(A) = QINTA0(A) / QA0(A);
CDV(A) = yes$(abs(sigva(A) - 1) < 1e-12);
rva(A)$(not CDV(A)) = 1 / sigva(A) - 1;
* Nests (17.2): each is valued at its members' costs, at a price of one;
* shares within it follow from the members' prices and quantities
NFREE(F) = yes$(not sum(NST$NSTF(NST, F), 1));
parameters VNA0(NST, AC) "base value of a nest", rhn(NST) "exponent of a nest",
     dvn(NST, AC) "share of a nest in value added", an(NST, AC) "efficiency of a nest",
     dce(AC, AC) "share of a commodity in its nest", nden(NST, AC), tden(AC);
VNA0(NST, A) = sum(F$(NSTF(NST, F) and FA(F, A)), SAM(F, A) + TFA0(F, A))
               + sum(C$(NSTF(NST, C) and NE(C, A)), SAM(C, A));
NNA(NST, A) = yes$(VNA0(NST, A) > tol);
abort$(sum(NST$(not sum(A$NNA(NST, A), 1)), 1)) "a nest of value added is used by no activity";
CDN(NST) = yes$(abs(signest(NST) - 1) < 1e-12);
rhn(NST)$(not CDN(NST)) = 1 / signest(NST) - 1;
nden(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and not CDN(NST))
    = sum(F$(NSTF(NST, F) and FA(F, A)), W0(F) * WFD0(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) * QF0(F, A)**(1 + rhn(NST)))
      + sum(C$(NSTF(NST, C) and NE(C, A)), (1 + tv(C) * (1 - kappa(A))) * QINT0(C, A)**(1 + rhn(NST)));
dva(F, A)$(FA(F, A) and not NFREE(F))
    = sum(NST$(NSTF(NST, F) and CDN(NST)), (SAM(F, A) + TFA0(F, A)) / VNA0(NST, A))
      + sum(NST$(NSTF(NST, F) and not CDN(NST)), W0(F) * WFD0(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) * QF0(F, A)**(1 + rhn(NST))
                                                  / nden(NST, A));
dce(C, A)$NE(C, A)
    = sum(NST$(NSTF(NST, C) and CDN(NST)), SAM(C, A) / VNA0(NST, A))
      + sum(NST$(NSTF(NST, C) and not CDN(NST)), (1 + tv(C) * (1 - kappa(A))) * QINT0(C, A)**(1 + rhn(NST))
                                                  / nden(NST, A));
an(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and CDN(NST)) = VNA0(NST, A)
    / (prod(F$(NSTF(NST, F) and FA(F, A)), QF0(F, A)**dva(F, A)) * prod(C$(NSTF(NST, C) and NE(C, A)), QINT0(C, A)**dce(C, A)));
an(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and not CDN(NST)) = VNA0(NST, A)
    / (sum(F$(NSTF(NST, F) and FA(F, A)), dva(F, A) * QF0(F, A)**(-rhn(NST)))
       + sum(C$(NSTF(NST, C) and NE(C, A)), dce(C, A) * QINT0(C, A)**(-rhn(NST))))**(-1 / rhn(NST));
* The top of value added: the factors in no nest, and the nests
dva(F, A)$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F) and CDV(A)) = (SAM(F, A) + TFA0(F, A)) / QVA0(A);
dvn(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and CDV(A)) = VNA0(NST, A) / QVA0(A);
ad(A)$CDV(A) = QVA0(A) / (prod(F$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F)), QF0(F, A)**dva(F, A))
                          * prod(NST$NNA(NST, A), VNA0(NST, A)**dvn(NST, A)));
tden(A)$(not CDV(A)) = sum(F$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F)), W0(F) * WFD0(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) * QF0(F, A)**(1 + rva(A)))
                       + sum(NST$NNA(NST, A), VNA0(NST, A)**(1 + rva(A)));
dva(F, A)$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F) and not CDV(A)) = W0(F) * WFD0(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) * QF0(F, A)**(1 + rva(A)) / tden(A);
dvn(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and not CDV(A)) = VNA0(NST, A)**(1 + rva(A)) / tden(A);
ad(A)$(not CDV(A)) = QVA0(A) / (sum(F$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F)), dva(F, A) * QF0(F, A)**(-rva(A)))
                                + sum(NST$NNA(NST, A), dvn(NST, A) * VNA0(NST, A)**(-rva(A))))**(-1 / rva(A));
* Top nest: Leontief (siga = 0, or no intermediate inputs), Cobb-Douglas (1) or CES
PINTA0(A) = sum(C, ica(C, A) * (1 + tv(C) * (1 - kappa(A))));
LT(A) = yes$(siga(A) = 0 or QINTA0(A) <= 0);
CDA(A) = yes$(not LT(A) and abs(siga(A) - 1) < 1e-12);
rha(A)$(not LT(A) and not CDA(A)) = 1 / siga(A) - 1;
ratioa(A)$(not LT(A)) = (1 / PINTA0(A)) * (QVA0(A) / QINTA0(A))**(1 + rha(A));
dla(A)$(not LT(A)) = ratioa(A) / (1 + ratioa(A));
dlac(A)$(not LT(A)) = 1 / (1 + ratioa(A));
valuea(A) = QVA0(A) + PINTA0(A) * QINTA0(A);
dla(A)$CDA(A) = QVA0(A) / valuea(A);
dlac(A)$CDA(A) = PINTA0(A) * QINTA0(A) / valuea(A);
aa(A) = 1;
aa(A)$CDA(A) = QA0(A) / (QVA0(A)**dla(A) * QINTA0(A)**dlac(A));
aa(A)$(not LT(A) and not CDA(A)) = QA0(A) / (dla(A) * QVA0(A)**(-rha(A))
                                      + dlac(A) * QINTA0(A)**(-rha(A)))**(-1 / rha(A));
* 17.3 Output of a commodity from several activities (from version 0.5.2): a
* CES or Cobb-Douglas aggregate of the activities' outputs for the commodities
* with an elasticity sigac (0, perfect substitutes, otherwise)
sets CAC(AC) "commodities aggregated from several activities", CDAC(AC) "Cobb-Douglas aggregates",
     XAC(AC, AC) "output of a commodity by an activity, aggregated";
parameters rac(AC) "exponent of the aggregate", dac(AC, AC) "share of an activity", aac(AC) "efficiency";
CAC(C) = yes$(sigac(C) > 0);
abort$(sum(C$(CAC(C) and sum(A$(SAM(A, C) > tol), 1) < 2), 1)) "sigac: a commodity produced by one activity only";
CDAC(C) = yes$(CAC(C) and abs(sigac(C) - 1) < 1e-12);
XAC(A, C) = yes$(CAC(C) and SAM(A, C) > tol);
rac(C)$(CAC(C) and not CDAC(C)) = 1 / sigac(C) - 1;
dac(A, C)$(XAC(A, C) and CDAC(C)) = SAM(A, C) / QX0(C);
dac(A, C)$(XAC(A, C) and not CDAC(C)) = SAM(A, C)**(1 + rac(C)) / sum(AP$XAC(AP, C), SAM(AP, C)**(1 + rac(C)));
aac(C) = 1;
aac(C)$CDAC(C) = QX0(C) / prod(A$XAC(A, C), SAM(A, C)**dac(A, C));
aac(C)$(CAC(C) and not CDAC(C)) = QX0(C) / sum(A$XAC(A, C), dac(A, C) * SAM(A, C)**(-rac(C)))**(-1 / rac(C));

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* 7.4 CET and Armington functions (complements of the shares stored)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
parameters rt(AC), ratiot(AC), dt(AC), dtc(AC), at(AC), rq(AC), ratioq(AC), dq(AC), dqc(AC), aq(AC);
rt(C) = 1 / sigt(C) + 1;
dt(C) = 0.5;
dtc(C) = 0.5;
at(C) = 1;
ratiot(C)$(CE(C) and not XO(C)) = (QE0(C) / QD0(C))**(rt(C) - 1);
dt(C)$(CE(C) and not XO(C)) = 1 / (1 + ratiot(C));
dtc(C)$(CE(C) and not XO(C)) = ratiot(C) / (1 + ratiot(C));
at(C)$(CE(C) and not XO(C)) = QX0(C) / (dt(C) * QE0(C)**rt(C) + dtc(C) * QD0(C)**rt(C))**(1 / rt(C));
rq(C) = 1 / sigq(C) - 1;
dq(C) = 0.5;
dqc(C) = 0.5;
aq(C)$CDO(C) = QQ0(C) / QD0(C);
aq(C)$(CM(C) and not CDO(C)) = QQ0(C) / QM0(C);
ratioq(C)$(CM(C) and CDO(C)) = (PM0(C) / PDD0(C)) * (QM0(C) / QD0(C))**(1 + rq(C));
dq(C)$(CM(C) and CDO(C)) = ratioq(C) / (1 + ratioq(C));
dqc(C)$(CM(C) and CDO(C)) = 1 / (1 + ratioq(C));
aq(C)$(CM(C) and CDO(C)) = QQ0(C) / (dq(C) * QM0(C)**(-rq(C)) + dqc(C) * QD0(C)**(-rq(C)))**(-1 / rq(C));

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* 7.5 Institutions
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
parameters YF0(AC), YIF0(AC, AC), tshi(AC), shif(AC, AC), trfr(AC), YI0(AC), dtx(AC), dsv(AC),
     tins0(AC), mps0(AC), DY0(AC), safe(AC), shii(AC, AC), shir(AC), QH0(AC, AC), EH0(AC), hc(AC),
     beta(AC, AC), gamma(AC, AC), bb(AC, AC), trdg(AC), trdr(AC), qgbar(AC), qinvbar(AC), qshibar(AC),
     betah(AC, AC), gammah(AC, AC), bbh(AC, AC), QHA0(AC, AC),
     cwts(AC), dwts(AC);
scalars trgr, trrg, trgg, YSHI0, sshi, trshi, trshir, YG0, EG0, GSAV0, FSAV0;
YF0(F) = sum(AC, SAM(F, AC));
YIF0(INS, F) = SAM(INS, F);
tshi(F) = sum(SHIS, SAM(SHIS, F)) / YF0(F);
* Taxes on factor income (from version 0.5.0), taken before distribution
parameter tfy(AC) "tax rate on factor income";
tfy(F) = sum(FYTAXS, SAM(FYTAXS, F)) / YF0(F);
shif(INS, F)$(not SHIS(INS)) = YIF0(INS, F) / ((1 - tshi(F) - tfy(F)) * YF0(F));
trfr(F) = sum(ROWS, SAM(F, ROWS));
YI0(D) = sum(AC, SAM(D, AC));
dtx(D) = sum(DTAXS, SAM(DTAXS, D));
dsv(D) = sum(SAVS, SAM(SAVS, D));
tins0(D) = dtx(D) / YI0(D);
mps0(D) = dsv(D) / ((1 - tins0(D)) * YI0(D));
DY0(D) = YI0(D) - dtx(D) - dsv(D);
safe(D) = DY0(D)$(abs(DY0(D)) > tol) + 1$(abs(DY0(D)) <= tol);
shii(D, DP) = SAM(D, DP) / safe(DP);
shir(D) = sum(ROWS, SAM(ROWS, D)) / safe(D);
QH0(C, H) = SAM(C, H) / (1 + tv(C));
QHA0(A, H) = SAM(A, H);
EH0(H) = sum(C, SAM(C, H)) + sum(A, SAM(A, H));
hc(H) = EH0(H) / safe(H);
beta(C, H)$(EH0(H) > 0) = SAM(C, H) / EH0(H);
betah(A, H)$(EH0(H) > 0) = SAM(A, H) / EH0(H);
gamma(C, H) = 0;
gammah(A, H) = 0;
if (les,
* LES: marginal shares in proportion to the income elasticities supplied
    bb(C, H) = incel(C) * beta(C, H);
* home goods take the elasticity of the activity's paired commodity (incelh)
    bbh(A, H) = incelh(A) * betah(A, H);
    beta(C, H) = bb(C, H) / (sum(CP, bb(CP, H)) + sum(AP, bbh(AP, H)));
    betah(A, H) = bbh(A, H) / (sum(CP, bb(CP, H)) + sum(AP, bbh(AP, H)));
    gamma(C, H) = QH0(C, H) + beta(C, H) * EH0(H) / frisch(H) / (1 + tv(C));
    gammah(A, H) = QHA0(A, H) + betah(A, H) * EH0(H) / frisch(H);
);
trdg(D) = sum(GOVS, SAM(D, GOVS));
trdr(D) = sum(ROWS, SAM(D, ROWS));
trgr = sum((GOVS, ROWS), SAM(GOVS, ROWS));
trrg = sum((ROWS, GOVS), SAM(ROWS, GOVS));
trgg = sum(GOVS, SAM(GOVS, GOVS));
qgbar(C) = sum(GOVS, SAM(C, GOVS)) / (1 + tv(C));
qinvbar(C) = sum(SAVS, SAM(C, SAVS)) / (1 + tv(C));
qshibar(C) = sum(SHIS, SAM(C, SHIS)) / (1 + tv(C));
YSHI0 = sum((SHIS, AC), SAM(SHIS, AC));
sshi = 0;
sshi$fund = sum((SAVS, SHIS), SAM(SAVS, SHIS)) / YSHI0;
trshi = sum((SHIS, GOVS), SAM(SHIS, GOVS));
trshir = sum((SHIS, ROWS), SAM(SHIS, ROWS));
cwts(C) = sum(H, SAM(C, H)) / sum((CP, H), SAM(CP, H)) / (1 + tv(C));
dwts(C) = QD0(C) / sum(CP, QD0(CP));
YG0 = sum((GOVS, AC), SAM(GOVS, AC));
EG0 = sum((C, GOVS), SAM(C, GOVS)) + sum(D, trdg(D)) + trgg + trrg + trshi;

* 12.3 Public debt: interest on the stated debt is separated from the
* government's transfers to domestic institutions (shares hold) and abroad
parameters hold(AC) "share of domestic interest received";
scalars ddebt, fdebt, rd, rf, phi;
ddebt = ddebtin;  fdebt = fdebtin;  rd = rdin;  rf = rfin;
hold(D) = holdin(D);
hold(D)$(debtin and not holdgiven and sum(DP, max(trdg(DP), 0)) > 0)
    = max(trdg(D), 0) / sum(DP, max(trdg(DP), 0));
phi = phiin;
phi$(debtin and not phigiven and ddebt + fdebt > 0) = fdebt / (ddebt + fdebt);
trdg(D) = trdg(D) - hold(D) * rd * ddebt;
trrg = trrg - rf * fdebt;
abort$(smin(D, trdg(D)) < -tol) "transfers smaller than interest";
GSAV0 = sum((SAVS, GOVS), SAM(SAVS, GOVS));
FSAV0 = sum((SAVS, ROWS), SAM(SAVS, ROWS));

* Health link (from version 0.1.14) and factor efficiency
parameters af(AC);
scalars linked, hs0;
af(F) = 1;
* 15.2 Days lost to illness: base shares and elasticities given by the user;
* a death rate with a non-zero elasticity also needs health services
set FS(AC) "factors with days lost to illness";
parameters sick0(AC) "base share of working time lost", sick(AC) "share lost before the response to services",
     epss(AC) "elasticity of the share lost";
FS(F) = yes$sickgiven(F);
sick0(F) = sickin(F);
sick(F) = sick0(F);
epss(F) = sickelin(F);
linked = 1$(sum(F$(eta(F) <> 0), 1) + sum(F$(epss(F) <> 0), 1) + 1$(mortelin <> 0) > 0);
hs0 = 1;
hs0$linked = sum(C$HCOM(C), sum(H, QH0(C, H)) + qgbar(C) + qshibar(C));

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* 14 Labour-market regimes: the labour force from the base unemployment
* rate given by the user; the real minimum wage is the base real wage when
* there is unemployment in the base (so that U (W/(CPI wmin) - 1) = mu),
* and a share of it with full employment, when the base rate is mu/(1/r - 1)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
set FL(AC) "factors with a labour force";
parameters u0(AC) "base unemployment rate", qlf(AC) "labour force", epsw(AC) "wage-curve elasticity",
     wref(AC) "reference real wage", wmin(AC) "real minimum wage", lsm0(AC), QFS0(AC);
scalar mu "smoothing of the minimum-wage condition";
mu = muin;
FL(F) = yes$(ungiven(F) or mwgiven(F));
QFS0(F) = sum(A, QF0(F, A));
wref(F) = W0(F) / sum(C, cwts(C) * (1 + tv(C)));
u0(F) = 1;
u0(F)$FL(F) = unin(F);
wmin(F) = wref(F);
wmin(F)$(FL(F) and u0(F) > 0) = wref(F) / (1 + mu / u0(F));
wmin(F)$(FL(F) and u0(F) = 0) = mwin(F) * wref(F);
u0(F)$(FL(F) and u0(F) = 0) = mu / (1 / mwin(F) - 1);
qlf(F) = QFS0(F);
qlf(F)$FL(F) = QFS0(F) / (1 - u0(F));
epsw(F) = wcin(F);
lsm0(F)$FL(F) = (1 - QFS0(F) / qlf(F)) + (wref(F) / wmin(F) - 1)
                - sqrt(sqr(1 - QFS0(F) / qlf(F)) + sqr(wref(F) / wmin(F) - 1) + 2 * mu);

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Variables and equations (Section 5)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
variables PA(AC), PVA(AC), PINTA(AC), PX(AC), PD(AC), PE(AC), PM(AC), PQ(AC), W(AC), EXR, CPI, DPI,
     QA(AC), QVA(AC), QINTA(AC), QF(AC, AC), QINT(AC, AC), QX(AC), QD(AC), QE(AC), QM(AC), QQ(AC),
     QH(AC, AC), QG(AC), QINV(AC), QFS(AC), YF(AC), YIF(AC, AC), YI(AC), EH(AC), YG, EG, GSAV, FSAV,
     TINS(AC), MPS(AC), TINSADJ, MPSADJ, IADJ, GADJ, WFDIST(AC, AC), WALRAS, QT(AC), QER(AC), YSHI,
     SHIADJ, QSHI(AC), EFF(AC), HS, TQADJ, TMADJ, TVADJ, PWEV(AC), QHA(AC, AC), LSW(AC), LSM(AC), DW(AC),
     RM(AC), RE(AC), RA(AC), QNA(NST, AC), PNA(NST, AC), PXAC(AC, AC), QXAC(AC, AC);

* 16.1 Rents (from version 0.4.4): premiums on imports and exports, per unit
* of the world price, and rents on activity output, per unit of the activity
* price. Each is paid to the government unless a constraint names another
* recipient: a factor, a household or enterprise, or the rest of the world.
parameters rmto(AC, AC) "recipient of the premium on imports of a commodity",
     reto(AC, AC) "recipient of the premium on its exports", rato(AC, AC) "recipient of the rent on an activity's output";
rmto(GOVS, C) = 1;
reto(GOVS, C) = 1;
rato(GOVS, A) = 1;
* 17.2: the CES sum at the top of value added of activity za, and within nest zn
$macro TOPSUM(za) (sum(FP$(FA(FP, za) and NFREE(FP)), dva(FP, za) * (af(FP) * EFF(FP) * DW(FP) * QF(FP, za))**(-rva(za))) + sum(NSTP$NNA(NSTP, za), dvn(NSTP, za) * QNA(NSTP, za)**(-rva(za))))
$macro NSUM(zn, za) (sum(FP$(NSTF(zn, FP) and FA(FP, za)), dva(FP, za) * (af(FP) * EFF(FP) * DW(FP) * QF(FP, za))**(-rhn(zn))) + sum(CP$(NSTF(zn, CP) and NE(CP, za)), dce(CP, za) * QINT(CP, za)**(-rhn(zn))))
$macro RENTTO(rr) (sum(C, rmto(rr, C) * RM(C) * pwm(C) * QM(C)) * EXR + sum(C, reto(rr, C) * RE(C) * (PWEV(C)$CED(C) + pwe(C)$(not CED(C))) * QE(C)) * EXR + sum(A, rato(rr, A) * RA(A) * PA(A) * QA(A)))

* Built-in equation elements that user equations replace (from version
* 0.9.3): XRP(block, e1, e2) = 1, set in cge_user.inc, with '0' for an index a
* block does not have; the equations below leave them out
parameter XRP(*, *, *) "built-in equation elements replaced by user equations";
XRP('-', '-', '-') = 0;
* Variables added to built-in equation elements (from version 0.40.0):
* XADS(block, e1, e2), set in cge_user.inc with '0' for an index a block
* does not have, marks the elements; XADV, defined there, is added to their
* right side
set XADS(*, *, *) "built-in equation elements with variables added";
XADS('-', '-', '-') = no;
variable XADV(*, *, *) "variables added to built-in equation elements";

equations EP1(AC), EP2(AC), EP3(AC), EP4(AC), EP5(AC), EP6(AC), EP7(AC), EP8, EP9,
     EQ1(AC), EQ2(AC), EQ1C(AC), EQ2C(AC), EQ1D(AC), EQ2D(AC), EQ3C(AC), EQ3D(AC), EQ4C(AC, AC),
     EQ4D(AC, AC), EQ4N(NST, AC, AC), EQ4M(NST, AC, AC), EN1C(NST, AC), EN1D(NST, AC), EN2C(NST, AC),
     EN2D(NST, AC), EN3C(NST, AC, AC), EN3D(NST, AC, AC), EQ5(AC, AC), EQ6(AC), EQ6A(AC), EQ6D(AC),
     EQ6B(AC, AC), EP5A(AC, AC), EP5D(AC, AC), EH1, EH2(AC), EH3(AC),
     ET1(AC), ET2(AC), ET3(AC), ET4(AC), ET5(AC), ET6(AC), ET7(AC), ET8(AC), ET9(AC), ET3E(AC), ET10(AC),
     EI1(AC), EI2(AC, AC), EI3(AC), EI4(AC), EI5(AC, AC), EI5H(AC, AC), EI6(AC), EI7(AC), EI8, EI9, EI10(AC), EI11(AC),
     EI12, EI13(AC), EI14, EL1(AC), EL2(AC), ES1(AC), ES2(AC), ES3, ES4, ES5;

* 5.1 Prices
EP1(C)$(CM(C) and not XRP('P1', C, '0'))..  PM(C) =e= pwm(C) * (1 + tm(C) * TMADJ + RM(C)) * EXR + sum(CP$ici(CP, C), PQ(CP) * ici(CP, C)) + XADV('P1', C, '0')$XADS('P1', C, '0');
EP2(C)$(CE(C) and not XRP('P2', C, '0'))..  PE(C) =e= (PWEV(C)$CED(C) + pwe(C)$(not CED(C))) * (1 - te(C) - RE(C)) * EXR
                          - sum(CP$ice(CP, C), PQ(CP) * ice(CP, C)) + XADV('P2', C, '0')$XADS('P2', C, '0');
EP3(C)$(CQ(C) and not XRP('P3', C, '0'))..  PQ(C) * (1 - tq(C) * TQADJ) * QQ(C) =e=
                ((PD(C) + sum(CP$icd(CP, C), PQ(CP) * icd(CP, C))) * QD(C))$CDO(C) + (PM(C) * QM(C))$CM(C)
                + sum(CP$CT(CP), PQ(CP) * icm(CP, C)) * QQ(C) + XADV('P3', C, '0')$XADS('P3', C, '0');
EP4(C)$(CX(C) and not XRP('P4', C, '0'))..  PX(C) * QX(C) =e= (PD(C) * QD(C))$CDO(C) + (PE(C) * QE(C))$CE(C) + XADV('P4', C, '0')$XADS('P4', C, '0');
EP5(A)$(not XRP('P5', A, '0'))..        PA(A) =e= sum(C$theta(A, C), theta(A, C) * (PXAC(A, C)$XAC(A, C) + PX(C)$(not XAC(A, C)))) + XADV('P5', A, '0')$XADS('P5', A, '0');
EP6(A)$(not XRP('P6', A, '0'))..        PINTA(A) =e= sum(C$ica(C, A), PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ * (1 - kappa(A))) * ica(C, A)) + XADV('P6', A, '0')$XADS('P6', A, '0');
EP7(A)..        PA(A) * (1 - ta(A) - RA(A)) * QA(A) =e= PVA(A) * QVA(A) + PINTA(A) * QINTA(A) + XADV('P7', A, '0')$XADS('P7', A, '0');
EP8..           CPI =e= sum(C$cwts(C), cwts(C) * PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ)) + XADV('P8', '0', '0')$XADS('P8', '0', '0');
EP9..           DPI =e= sum(C$dwts(C), dwts(C) * PD(C)) + XADV('P9', '0', '0')$XADS('P9', '0', '0');

* 5.2 Production; factors in efficiency units af * EFF * QF
EQ1(A)$(LT(A) and not XRP('Q1', A, '0'))..  QVA(A) =e= iva(A) * QA(A) + XADV('Q1', A, '0')$XADS('Q1', A, '0');
EQ2(A)$(LT(A) and not XRP('Q2', A, '0'))..  QINTA(A) =e= inta(A) * QA(A) + XADV('Q2', A, '0')$XADS('Q2', A, '0');
EQ1C(A)$(not LT(A) and not CDA(A) and not XRP('Q1C', A, '0'))..
    QA(A) =e= aa(A) * (dla(A) * QVA(A)**(-rha(A)) + dlac(A) * QINTA(A)**(-rha(A)))**(-1 / rha(A)) + XADV('Q1C', A, '0')$XADS('Q1C', A, '0');
EQ2C(A)$(not LT(A) and not CDA(A) and not XRP('Q2C', A, '0'))..
    QVA(A) =e= QINTA(A) * ((PINTA(A) / PVA(A)) * dla(A) / dlac(A))**(1 / (1 + rha(A))) + XADV('Q2C', A, '0')$XADS('Q2C', A, '0');
EQ1D(A)$(CDA(A) and not XRP('Q1C', A, '0'))..  QA(A) =e= aa(A) * QVA(A)**dla(A) * QINTA(A)**dlac(A) + XADV('Q1C', A, '0')$XADS('Q1C', A, '0');
EQ2D(A)$(CDA(A) and not XRP('Q2C', A, '0'))..  PVA(A) * QVA(A) * dlac(A) =e= PINTA(A) * QINTA(A) * dla(A) + XADV('Q2C', A, '0')$XADS('Q2C', A, '0');
EQ3C(A)$(not CDV(A) and not XRP('Q3', A, '0'))..  QVA(A) =e= ad(A) * TOPSUM(A)**(-1 / rva(A)) + XADV('Q3', A, '0')$XADS('Q3', A, '0');
EQ3D(A)$(CDV(A) and not XRP('Q3', A, '0'))..
    QVA(A) =e= ad(A) * prod(F$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F)), (af(F) * EFF(F) * DW(F) * QF(F, A))**dva(F, A))
                     * prod(NST$NNA(NST, A), QNA(NST, A)**dvn(NST, A)) + XADV('Q3', A, '0')$XADS('Q3', A, '0');
EQ4C(F, A)$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F) and not CDV(A) and not XRP('Q4', F, A))..
    W(F) * WFDIST(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) =e= PVA(A) * QVA(A) / TOPSUM(A)
        * dva(F, A) * (af(F) * EFF(F) * DW(F) * QF(F, A))**(-rva(A) - 1) * af(F) * EFF(F) * DW(F) + XADV('Q4', F, A)$XADS('Q4', F, A);
EQ4D(F, A)$(FA(F, A) and NFREE(F) and CDV(A) and not XRP('Q4', F, A))..
    W(F) * WFDIST(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) * QF(F, A) =e= dva(F, A) * PVA(A) * QVA(A) + XADV('Q4', F, A)$XADS('Q4', F, A);
* 17.2 Nests of value added: demand for the factors in a nest (EQ4N, EQ4M),
* the quantity (EN1C, EN1D) and price (EN2C, EN2D) of each nest, and the
* demand for the commodities in nests (EN3C, EN3D)
EQ4N(NST, F, A)$(NSTF(NST, F) and FA(F, A) and not CDN(NST) and not XRP('Q4', F, A))..
    W(F) * WFDIST(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) =e= PNA(NST, A) * QNA(NST, A) / NSUM(NST, A)
        * dva(F, A) * (af(F) * EFF(F) * DW(F) * QF(F, A))**(-rhn(NST) - 1) * af(F) * EFF(F) * DW(F) + XADV('Q4', F, A)$XADS('Q4', F, A);
EQ4M(NST, F, A)$(NSTF(NST, F) and FA(F, A) and CDN(NST) and not XRP('Q4', F, A))..
    W(F) * WFDIST(F, A) * (1 + tf(F, A)) * QF(F, A) =e= dva(F, A) * PNA(NST, A) * QNA(NST, A) + XADV('Q4', F, A)$XADS('Q4', F, A);
EN1C(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and not CDN(NST) and not XRP('N1', NST, A))..  QNA(NST, A) =e= an(NST, A) * NSUM(NST, A)**(-1 / rhn(NST)) + XADV('N1', NST, A)$XADS('N1', NST, A);
EN1D(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and CDN(NST) and not XRP('N1', NST, A))..
    QNA(NST, A) =e= an(NST, A) * prod(F$(NSTF(NST, F) and FA(F, A)), (af(F) * EFF(F) * DW(F) * QF(F, A))**dva(F, A))
                               * prod(C$(NSTF(NST, C) and NE(C, A)), QINT(C, A)**dce(C, A)) + XADV('N1', NST, A)$XADS('N1', NST, A);
EN2C(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and not CDV(A) and not XRP('N2', NST, A))..
    PNA(NST, A) =e= PVA(A) * QVA(A) / TOPSUM(A) * dvn(NST, A) * QNA(NST, A)**(-rva(A) - 1) + XADV('N2', NST, A)$XADS('N2', NST, A);
EN2D(NST, A)$(NNA(NST, A) and CDV(A) and not XRP('N2', NST, A))..  PNA(NST, A) * QNA(NST, A) =e= dvn(NST, A) * PVA(A) * QVA(A) + XADV('N2', NST, A)$XADS('N2', NST, A);
EN3C(NST, C, A)$(NSTF(NST, C) and NE(C, A) and not CDN(NST) and not XRP('N3', C, A))..
    PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ * (1 - kappa(A))) =e= PNA(NST, A) * QNA(NST, A) / NSUM(NST, A)
        * dce(C, A) * QINT(C, A)**(-rhn(NST) - 1) + XADV('N3', C, A)$XADS('N3', C, A);
EN3D(NST, C, A)$(NSTF(NST, C) and NE(C, A) and CDN(NST) and not XRP('N3', C, A))..
    PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ * (1 - kappa(A))) * QINT(C, A) =e= dce(C, A) * PNA(NST, A) * QNA(NST, A) + XADV('N3', C, A)$XADS('N3', C, A);
EQ5(C, A)$(ica(C, A) and not XRP('Q5', C, A))..  QINT(C, A) =e= ica(C, A) * QINTA(A) + XADV('Q5', C, A)$XADS('Q5', C, A);
EQ6(C)$(CX(C) and not CAC(C) and not XRP('Q6', C, '0'))..  QX(C) =e= sum(A$theta(A, C), theta(A, C) * (QA(A) - sum(H$betah(A, H), QHA(A, H)))) + XADV('Q6', C, '0')$XADS('Q6', C, '0');
* 17.3 Output from several activities: commodity output (EQ6A, EQ6D), each
* activity's output (EQ6B) and price (EP5A, EP5D)
EQ6A(C)$(CAC(C) and not CDAC(C) and not XRP('Q6A', C, '0'))..
    QX(C) =e= aac(C) * sum(A$XAC(A, C), dac(A, C) * QXAC(A, C)**(-rac(C)))**(-1 / rac(C)) + XADV('Q6A', C, '0')$XADS('Q6A', C, '0');
EQ6D(C)$(CDAC(C) and not XRP('Q6A', C, '0'))..  QX(C) =e= aac(C) * prod(A$XAC(A, C), QXAC(A, C)**dac(A, C)) + XADV('Q6A', C, '0')$XADS('Q6A', C, '0');
EQ6B(A, C)$(XAC(A, C) and not XRP('Q6B', A, C))..  QXAC(A, C) =e= theta(A, C) * (QA(A) - sum(H$betah(A, H), QHA(A, H))) + XADV('Q6B', A, C)$XADS('Q6B', A, C);
EP5A(A, C)$(XAC(A, C) and not CDAC(C) and not XRP('P5A', A, C))..
    PXAC(A, C) =e= PX(C) * QX(C) / sum(AP$XAC(AP, C), dac(AP, C) * QXAC(AP, C)**(-rac(C)))
                   * dac(A, C) * QXAC(A, C)**(-rac(C) - 1) + XADV('P5A', A, C)$XADS('P5A', A, C);
EP5D(A, C)$(XAC(A, C) and CDAC(C) and not XRP('P5A', A, C))..  PXAC(A, C) * QXAC(A, C) =e= dac(A, C) * PX(C) * QX(C) + XADV('P5A', A, C)$XADS('P5A', A, C);
EH1$(linked and not XRP('H1', '0', '0'))..    HS =e= sum(C$HCOM(C), sum(H$beta(C, H), QH(C, H)) + QG(C) + QSHI(C)$qshibar(C)) + XADV('H1', '0', '0')$XADS('H1', '0', '0');
EH2(F)$(eta(F) and not XRP('H2', F, '0')).. EFF(F) =e= (HS / hs0)**eta(F) + XADV('H2', F, '0')$XADS('H2', F, '0');
EH3(F)$(FS(F) and not XRP('H3', F, '0'))..  DW(F) =e= (1 - sick(F) * (HS / hs0)**epss(F)) / (1 - sick0(F)) + XADV('H3', F, '0')$XADS('H3', F, '0');

* 5.3 Trade
ET1(C)$(CE(C) and not XO(C) and not XRP('T1', C, '0'))..  QX(C) =e= at(C) * (dt(C) * QE(C)**rt(C) + dtc(C) * QD(C)**rt(C))**(1 / rt(C)) + XADV('T1', C, '0')$XADS('T1', C, '0');
ET2(C)$(CE(C) and not XO(C) and not XRP('T2', C, '0'))..  QE(C) =e= QD(C) * ((PE(C) / PD(C)) * dtc(C) / dt(C))**(1 / (rt(C) - 1)) + XADV('T2', C, '0')$XADS('T2', C, '0');
ET3(C)$(CX(C) and not CE(C) and not XRP('T3', C, '0'))..  QX(C) =e= QD(C) + XADV('T3', C, '0')$XADS('T3', C, '0');
ET3E(C)$(XO(C) and not XRP('T3E', C, '0'))..  QX(C) =e= QE(C) + XADV('T3E', C, '0')$XADS('T3E', C, '0');
ET4(C)$(CM(C) and CDO(C) and not XRP('T4', C, '0'))..
    QQ(C) =e= aq(C) * (dq(C) * QM(C)**(-rq(C)) + dqc(C) * QD(C)**(-rq(C)))**(-1 / rq(C)) + XADV('T4', C, '0')$XADS('T4', C, '0');
ET5(C)$(CM(C) and CDO(C) and not XRP('T5', C, '0'))..  QM(C) =e= QD(C) * (((PD(C) + sum(CP$icd(CP, C), PQ(CP) * icd(CP, C))) / PM(C))
                                               * dq(C) / dqc(C))**(1 / (1 + rq(C))) + XADV('T5', C, '0')$XADS('T5', C, '0');
ET6(C)$(CDO(C) and not CM(C) and not XRP('T6', C, '0'))..  QQ(C) =e= aq(C) * QD(C) + XADV('T6', C, '0')$XADS('T6', C, '0');
ET7(C)$(CM(C) and not CDO(C) and not XRP('T7', C, '0'))..  QQ(C) =e= aq(C) * QM(C) + XADV('T7', C, '0')$XADS('T7', C, '0');
ET8(C)$(CT(C) and not XRP('T8', C, '0'))..  QT(C) =e= sum(CP$icm(C, CP), icm(C, CP) * QQ(CP)) + sum(CP$icd(C, CP), icd(C, CP) * QD(CP))
                          + sum(CP$ici(C, CP), ici(C, CP) * QM(CP)) + sum(CP$ice(C, CP), ice(C, CP) * QE(CP)) + XADV('T8', C, '0')$XADS('T8', C, '0');
ET10(C)$(CED(C) and not XRP('T10', C, '0'))..  QE(C) =e= qebar(C) * (PWEV(C) / pwe(C))**(-etae(C)) + XADV('T10', C, '0')$XADS('T10', C, '0');
ET9(C)$(CR(C) and not XRP('T9', C, '0'))..  QER(C) =e= qerbar(C) * (PQ(C) / (EXR * pwe(C)))**(-sigt(C)) + XADV('T9', C, '0')$XADS('T9', C, '0');

* 5.4 Institutions
EI1(F)..  YF(F) =e= sum(A$FA(F, A), W(F) * WFDIST(F, A) * QF(F, A)) + trfr(F) * EXR + RENTTO(F) + XADV('I1', F, '0')$XADS('I1', F, '0');
EI2(INS, F)$(not XRP('I2', INS, F))..  YIF(INS, F) =e= (shif(INS, F) * (1 - tshi(F) - tfy(F)) * YF(F))$(not SHIS(INS))
                               + (tshi(F) * YF(F))$SHIS(INS) + XADV('I2', INS, F)$XADS('I2', INS, F);
EI3(D)$(not XRP('I3', D, '0'))..  YI(D) =e= sum(F, YIF(D, F)) + sum(DP$shii(D, DP), shii(D, DP) * (1 - MPS(DP)) * (1 - TINS(DP)) * YI(DP))
                    + trdg(D) * CPI + trdr(D) * EXR + hold(D) * rd * ddebt + RENTTO(D) + XADV('I3', D, '0')$XADS('I3', D, '0');
EI4(H)$(not XRP('I4', H, '0'))..  EH(H) =e= hc(H) * (1 - MPS(H)) * (1 - TINS(H)) * YI(H) + XADV('I4', H, '0')$XADS('I4', H, '0');
EI5(C, H)$(beta(C, H) and not XRP('I5', C, H))..
    PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ) * QH(C, H) =e= PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ) * gamma(C, H)
        + beta(C, H) * (EH(H) - sum(CP$gamma(CP, H), PQ(CP) * (1 + tv(CP) * TVADJ) * gamma(CP, H))
                        - sum(AP$gammah(AP, H), PA(AP) * gammah(AP, H))) + XADV('I5', C, H)$XADS('I5', C, H);
EI5H(A, H)$(betah(A, H) and not XRP('I5H', A, H))..
    PA(A) * QHA(A, H) =e= PA(A) * gammah(A, H)
        + betah(A, H) * (EH(H) - sum(CP$gamma(CP, H), PQ(CP) * (1 + tv(CP) * TVADJ) * gamma(CP, H))
                         - sum(AP$gammah(AP, H), PA(AP) * gammah(AP, H))) + XADV('I5H', A, H)$XADS('I5H', A, H);
EI6(C)$(not XRP('I6', C, '0'))..  QINV(C) =e= qinvbar(C) * IADJ + XADV('I6', C, '0')$XADS('I6', C, '0');
EI7(C)$(not XRP('I7', C, '0'))..  QG(C) =e= qgbar(C) * GADJ + XADV('I7', C, '0')$XADS('I7', C, '0');
EI8..     YG =e= sum(D, TINS(D) * YI(D)) + sum(C, tq(C) * TQADJ * PQ(C) * QQ(C))
                 + sum(C$CM(C), tm(C) * TMADJ * pwm(C) * QM(C)) * EXR
                 + sum(C$CE(C), te(C) * (PWEV(C)$CED(C) + pwe(C)$(not CED(C))) * QE(C)) * EXR
                 + sum(A, ta(A) * PA(A) * QA(A))
                 + TVADJ * sum(C$tv(C), tv(C) * PQ(C) * (sum(H$beta(C, H), QH(C, H)) + QG(C) + QINV(C)
                       + QSHI(C)$qshibar(C) + sum(A$QIX(C, A), (1 - kappa(A)) * QINT(C, A))))
                 + sum((GOVS, F), YIF(GOVS, F)) + trgr * EXR + trgg * CPI + sum(GOVS, RENTTO(GOVS))
                 + sum((F, A)$FA(F, A), tf(F, A) * W(F) * WFDIST(F, A) * QF(F, A)) + sum(F, tfy(F) * YF(F)) + XADV('I8', '0', '0')$XADS('I8', '0', '0');
EI9..     EG =e= sum(C, PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ) * QG(C)) + (sum(D, trdg(D)) + trgg + trshi) * CPI
                 + trrg * EXR + rd * ddebt + rf * fdebt * EXR + XADV('I9', '0', '0')$XADS('I9', '0', '0');
EI10(D)$(not XRP('I10', D, '0')).. TINS(D) =e= tins0(D) * TINSADJ + XADV('I10', D, '0')$XADS('I10', D, '0');
EI11(D)$(not XRP('I11', D, '0')).. MPS(D) =e= mps0(D) * MPSADJ + XADV('I11', D, '0')$XADS('I11', D, '0');
EI12$(fund and not XRP('I12', '0', '0'))..  YSHI =e= sum((SHIS, F), YIF(SHIS, F)) + trshi * CPI + trshir * EXR + XADV('I12', '0', '0')$XADS('I12', '0', '0');
EI13(C)$(qshibar(C) and not XRP('I13', C, '0'))..  QSHI(C) =e= qshibar(C) * SHIADJ + XADV('I13', C, '0')$XADS('I13', C, '0');
EI14$(fund and not XRP('I14', '0', '0'))..  sum(C$qshibar(C), PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ) * QSHI(C)) =e= (1 - sshi) * YSHI + XADV('I14', '0', '0')$XADS('I14', '0', '0');

* 14 Labour-market regimes: wage curve (L1) and smoothed minimum wage (L2);
* each is inert unless the closure fixes its slack
EL1(F)$(FL(F) and not XRP('L1', F, '0'))..  W(F) / CPI =e= (wref(F) * ((1 - QFS(F) / qlf(F)) / u0(F))**(-epsw(F)))$(epsw(F) > 0)
                               + wref(F)$(epsw(F) = 0) + LSW(F) + XADV('L1', F, '0')$XADS('L1', F, '0');
EL2(F)$(FL(F) and not XRP('L2', F, '0'))..  (1 - QFS(F) / qlf(F)) + (W(F) / (CPI * wmin(F)) - 1)
                - sqrt(sqr(1 - QFS(F) / qlf(F)) + sqr(W(F) / (CPI * wmin(F)) - 1) + 2 * mu) =e= LSM(F) + XADV('L2', F, '0')$XADS('L2', F, '0');

* 5.5 System constraints (S6 through the closure)
ES1(F)..  sum(A$FA(F, A), QF(F, A)) =e= QFS(F) + XADV('S1', F, '0')$XADS('S1', F, '0');
ES2(C)$CQ(C)..  QQ(C) =e= sum(A$QIX(C, A), QINT(C, A)) + sum(H$beta(C, H), QH(C, H)) + QG(C) + QINV(C)
                    + QT(C)$CT(C) + QER(C)$CR(C) + QSHI(C)$qshibar(C) + XADV('S2', C, '0')$XADS('S2', C, '0');
ES3..     sum(C$CM(C), pwm(C) * QM(C)) + (sum((ROWS, F), YIF(ROWS, F))
              + sum(D, shir(D) * (1 - MPS(D)) * (1 - TINS(D)) * YI(D)) + sum(ROWS, RENTTO(ROWS))) / EXR
          + trrg + rf * fdebt
          =e= sum(C$CE(C), (PWEV(C)$CED(C) + pwe(C)$(not CED(C))) * QE(C)) + sum(C$CR(C), PQ(C) * QER(C)) / EXR
              + sum(D, trdr(D))
              + sum(F, trfr(F)) + trgr + trshir + FSAV + XADV('S3', '0', '0')$XADS('S3', '0', '0');
ES4$(not XRP('S4', '0', '0'))..     YG =e= EG + GSAV + XADV('S4', '0', '0')$XADS('S4', '0', '0');
ES5..     sum(D, MPS(D) * (1 - TINS(D)) * YI(D)) + GSAV + sshi * YSHI + EXR * FSAV
          =e= sum(C, PQ(C) * (1 + tv(C) * TVADJ) * QINV(C)) + WALRAS + XADV('S5', '0', '0')$XADS('S5', '0', '0');

* User variables and equations (from version 0.6.1, model_spec.md, Section
* 19), written by cge_gams
$if exist cge_user.inc $include cge_user.inc

model cge / all /;
* For NLP solvers (--cgetype=nlp): the same equations and a constant objective
variable OBJ "constant objective";
equation EOBJ;
EOBJ..  OBJ =e= 0;
model cgenlp / cge, EOBJ /;
* As a mixed complementarity problem (--cgetype=mcp): the equations of the
* base; a scenario with constraints adds their pairs (model cgecon)
model cgebase / cge /;
scalar mstat "model status of the last solve";
scalar mcpmode "1 when solved as a mixed complementarity problem";
mcpmode = 0;
$ifi %cgetype% == mcp mcpmode = 1;

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Base values (Section 7.1: base prices normalised to one)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
PA.l(A) = 1;  PVA.l(A) = 1;  PINTA.l(A) = PINTA0(A);  PX.l(C) = 1;  PD.l(C) = 1;
PE.l(C) = 1$CE(C);  PM.l(C) = PM0(C);  PQ.l(C) = 1;  W.l(F) = W0(F);  EXR.l = 1;
PWEV.l(C) = pwe(C);  QHA.l(A, H) = QHA0(A, H);
CPI.l = sum(C, cwts(C) * (1 + tv(C)));  DPI.l = sum(C, dwts(C));
QA.l(A) = QA0(A);  QVA.l(A) = QVA0(A);  QINTA.l(A) = QINTA0(A);  QF.l(F, A) = QF0(F, A);
QINT.l(C, A) = QINT0(C, A);  QX.l(C) = QX0(C);  QD.l(C) = QD0(C);  QE.l(C) = QE0(C);
QM.l(C) = QM0(C)$CM(C);  QQ.l(C) = QQ0(C);  QH.l(C, H) = QH0(C, H);  QG.l(C) = qgbar(C);
QINV.l(C) = qinvbar(C);  QFS.l(F) = sum(A, QF0(F, A));  YF.l(F) = YF0(F);  YIF.l(INS, F) = YIF0(INS, F);
YI.l(D) = YI0(D);  EH.l(H) = EH0(H);  YG.l = YG0;  EG.l = EG0;  GSAV.l = GSAV0;  FSAV.l = FSAV0;
TINS.l(D) = tins0(D);  MPS.l(D) = mps0(D);  TINSADJ.l = 1;  MPSADJ.l = 1;  IADJ.l = 1;  GADJ.l = 1;
WFDIST.l(F, A) = WFD0(F, A);  WALRAS.l = 0;  QT.l(C) = QT0(C);  QER.l(C) = QER0(C);  YSHI.l = YSHI0;
SHIADJ.l = 1;  QSHI.l(C) = qshibar(C);  EFF.l(F) = 1;  HS.l = hs0;  DW.l(F) = 1;
TQADJ.l = 1;  TMADJ.l = 1;  TVADJ.l = 1;  LSW.l(F) = 0;  LSM.l(F) = lsm0(F);
RM.l(C) = 0;  RE.l(C) = 0;  RA.l(A) = 0;
QNA.l(NST, A) = VNA0(NST, A);  PNA.l(NST, A) = 1$NNA(NST, A);
PXAC.l(A, C) = 1$XAC(A, C);  QXAC.l(A, C) = SAM(A, C)$XAC(A, C);

* Closure (Section 6): 1 = the default of each block
scalars clext "1 flexible exchange rate, 2 fixed",
        clgov "1 flexible government savings; fixed, with 2 direct, 3 sales, 4 import or 5 VAT rates adjusting",
        clsi "1 savings-driven, 2 investment-driven", clnum "1 CPI numeraire, 2 DPI";
parameter fclo(AC) "factor closure: 1 mobile, 2 activity-specific, 3 unemployed, 4 wage curve, 5 minimum wage";
clext = 1;  clgov = 1;  clsi = 1;  clnum = 1;  fclo(F) = 1;

$include cge_closure.gms

* Convergence tolerances are absolute: scale them to the size of the SAM,
* within what double precision allows. An option file is written for PATH,
* CONOPT, IPOPT and KNITRO; other solvers use their defaults.
scalar ptol;
ptol = max(1e-11, 1e-13 * smax((AC, ACP), abs(SAM(AC, ACP))));
file optf / %cgesolver%.opt /;
* put files print numbers below .nz as zero (default 1e-5)
optf.nz = 0;
optf.nr = 2;
optf.nd = 3;
$ifi %cgesolver% == path   putclose optf 'convergence_tolerance ', ptol:0:3 /;
$ifi %cgesolver% == conopt putclose optf 'rtnwma ', (ptol / max(1, smax((AC, ACP), abs(SAM(AC, ACP))))):0:3 /;
$ifi %cgesolver% == ipopt  putclose optf 'tol 1e-12' / 'constr_viol_tol ', ptol:0:3 /;
$ifi %cgesolver% == knitro putclose optf 'feastol_abs ', ptol:0:3 / 'feastol 1e-12' /;
cge.optfile = 0;
$ifi %cgesolver% == path   cge.optfile = 1;
$ifi %cgesolver% == conopt cge.optfile = 1;
$ifi %cgesolver% == ipopt  cge.optfile = 1;
$ifi %cgesolver% == knitro cge.optfile = 1;
cgenlp.optfile = cge.optfile;
cgebase.optfile = cge.optfile;
option limrow = 0, limcol = 0, solprint = off;
$batinclude cge_solve.gms cgebase

file res / '%out%' /;
$batinclude cge_write.gms res __base__
@@@ cge_closure.gms
* cge_closure.gms -- bounds, variables that do not exist, and the closure (Section 6)
* Included by cge_model.gms, by cge_scenario.gms (the check) and by the driver
* that cge_gams writes (cge_run.gms). Every variable is freed, then
* fixed where the model structure or the closure requires it, at its current level.

PA.lo(AC) = -inf;      PA.up(AC) = inf;      PVA.lo(AC) = -inf;     PVA.up(AC) = inf;
PINTA.lo(AC) = -inf;   PINTA.up(AC) = inf;   PX.lo(AC) = -inf;      PX.up(AC) = inf;
PD.lo(AC) = -inf;      PD.up(AC) = inf;      PE.lo(AC) = -inf;      PE.up(AC) = inf;
PM.lo(AC) = -inf;      PM.up(AC) = inf;      PQ.lo(AC) = -inf;      PQ.up(AC) = inf;
W.lo(AC) = -inf;       W.up(AC) = inf;       EXR.lo = -inf;         EXR.up = inf;
CPI.lo = -inf;         CPI.up = inf;         DPI.lo = -inf;         DPI.up = inf;
QA.lo(AC) = -inf;      QA.up(AC) = inf;      QVA.lo(AC) = -inf;     QVA.up(AC) = inf;
QINTA.lo(AC) = -inf;   QINTA.up(AC) = inf;   QF.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; QF.up(AC, ACP) = inf;
QINT.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; QINT.up(AC, ACP) = inf; QX.lo(AC) = -inf;  QX.up(AC) = inf;
QD.lo(AC) = -inf;      QD.up(AC) = inf;      QE.lo(AC) = -inf;      QE.up(AC) = inf;
QM.lo(AC) = -inf;      QM.up(AC) = inf;      QQ.lo(AC) = -inf;      QQ.up(AC) = inf;
QH.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; QH.up(AC, ACP) = inf; QG.lo(AC) = -inf;      QG.up(AC) = inf;
QINV.lo(AC) = -inf;    QINV.up(AC) = inf;    QFS.lo(AC) = -inf;     QFS.up(AC) = inf;
YF.lo(AC) = -inf;      YF.up(AC) = inf;      YIF.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; YIF.up(AC, ACP) = inf;
YI.lo(AC) = -inf;      YI.up(AC) = inf;      EH.lo(AC) = -inf;      EH.up(AC) = inf;
YG.lo = -inf;          YG.up = inf;          EG.lo = -inf;          EG.up = inf;
GSAV.lo = -inf;        GSAV.up = inf;        FSAV.lo = -inf;        FSAV.up = inf;
TINS.lo(AC) = -inf;    TINS.up(AC) = inf;    MPS.lo(AC) = -inf;     MPS.up(AC) = inf;
TINSADJ.lo = -inf;     TINSADJ.up = inf;     MPSADJ.lo = -inf;      MPSADJ.up = inf;
IADJ.lo = -inf;        IADJ.up = inf;        GADJ.lo = -inf;        GADJ.up = inf;
WFDIST.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; WFDIST.up(AC, ACP) = inf; WALRAS.lo = -inf; WALRAS.up = inf;
QT.lo(AC) = -inf;      QT.up(AC) = inf;      QER.lo(AC) = -inf;     QER.up(AC) = inf;
YSHI.lo = -inf;        YSHI.up = inf;        SHIADJ.lo = -inf;      SHIADJ.up = inf;
QSHI.lo(AC) = -inf;    QSHI.up(AC) = inf;    EFF.lo(AC) = -inf;     EFF.up(AC) = inf;
HS.lo = -inf;          HS.up = inf;
TQADJ.lo = -inf;       TQADJ.up = inf;       TMADJ.lo = -inf;       TMADJ.up = inf;
TVADJ.lo = -inf;       TVADJ.up = inf;
PWEV.lo(AC) = -inf;     PWEV.up(AC) = inf;     QHA.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; QHA.up(AC, ACP) = inf;
LSW.lo(AC) = -inf;      LSW.up(AC) = inf;      LSM.lo(AC) = -inf;      LSM.up(AC) = inf;
DW.lo(AC) = -inf;       DW.up(AC) = inf;
RM.lo(AC) = -inf;       RM.up(AC) = inf;       RE.lo(AC) = -inf;       RE.up(AC) = inf;
RA.lo(AC) = -inf;       RA.up(AC) = inf;
QNA.lo(NST, AC) = -inf; QNA.up(NST, AC) = inf; PNA.lo(NST, AC) = -inf; PNA.up(NST, AC) = inf;
PXAC.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; PXAC.up(AC, ACP) = inf; QXAC.lo(AC, ACP) = -inf; QXAC.up(AC, ACP) = inf;

* Prices and quantities that are positive in the base stay positive; as a
* mixed complementarity problem (from version 0.4.4) every variable without a
* pair must be free or fixed, so these bounds are left out
if (mcpmode = 0,
PA.lo(A) = 1e-10;  PVA.lo(A) = 1e-10;  PQ.lo(C)$CQ(C) = 1e-10;  W.lo(F) = 1e-10;  EXR.lo = 1e-10;
CPI.lo = 1e-10;  DPI.lo = 1e-10;  QA.lo(A) = 1e-10;  QVA.lo(A) = 1e-10;  QQ.lo(C)$CQ(C) = 1e-10;
PWEV.lo(C)$CED(C) = 1e-10;
PINTA.lo(A)$(PINTA0(A) > 0) = 1e-10;  QINTA.lo(A)$(QINTA0(A) > 0) = 1e-10;
PX.lo(C)$CX(C) = 1e-10;  PD.lo(C)$CDO(C) = 1e-10;  QX.lo(C)$CX(C) = 1e-10;  QD.lo(C)$CDO(C) = 1e-10;
PE.lo(C)$CE(C) = 1e-10;  QE.lo(C)$CE(C) = 1e-10;  PM.lo(C)$CM(C) = 1e-10;  QM.lo(C)$CM(C) = 1e-10;
QF.lo(F, A)$FA(F, A) = 1e-10;  QT.lo(C)$CT(C) = 1e-10;  QER.lo(C)$CR(C) = 1e-10;
EFF.lo(F)$eta(F) = 1e-10;  HS.lo$linked = 1e-10;  DW.lo(F)$FS(F) = 1e-10;
QNA.lo(NST, A)$NNA(NST, A) = 1e-10;  PNA.lo(NST, A)$NNA(NST, A) = 1e-10;  QINT.lo(C, A)$NE(C, A) = 1e-10;
PXAC.lo(A, C)$XAC(A, C) = 1e-10;  QXAC.lo(A, C)$XAC(A, C) = 1e-10;
* the wage curve needs positive unemployment
QFS.up(F)$(FL(F) and epsw(F) > 0) = qlf(F) * (1 - 1e-12);
);

* Variables that do not exist are held at their base values
PE.fx(C)$(not CE(C)) = PE.l(C);        QE.fx(C)$(not CE(C)) = QE.l(C);
PM.fx(C)$(not CM(C)) = PM.l(C);        QM.fx(C)$(not CM(C)) = QM.l(C);
PX.fx(C)$(not CX(C)) = PX.l(C);        PD.fx(C)$(not CDO(C)) = PD.l(C);
QX.fx(C)$(not CX(C)) = QX.l(C);        QD.fx(C)$(not CDO(C)) = QD.l(C);
PQ.fx(C)$(not CQ(C)) = PQ.l(C);        QQ.fx(C)$(not CQ(C)) = QQ.l(C);
PWEV.fx(C)$(not CED(C)) = PWEV.l(C);     QHA.fx(A, H)$(not betah(A, H)) = 0;
QF.fx(F, A)$(not FA(F, A)) = 0;        WFDIST.fx(F, A)$(not FA(F, A)) = WFDIST.l(F, A);
QT.fx(C)$(not CT(C)) = 0;              QER.fx(C)$(not CR(C)) = 0;
QINT.fx(C, A)$(not QIX(C, A)) = 0;     QH.fx(C, H)$(not beta(C, H)) = 0;
QSHI.fx(C)$(not qshibar(C)) = 0;       EFF.fx(F)$(not eta(F)) = EFF.l(F);
YSHI.fx$(not fund) = YSHI.l;           SHIADJ.fx$(not fund) = SHIADJ.l;
HS.fx$(not linked) = HS.l;
LSW.fx(F)$(not FL(F)) = 0;             LSM.fx(F)$(not FL(F)) = 0;
DW.fx(F)$(not FS(F)) = 1;
* Rents (16.1) are fixed unless a constraint frees them
RM.fx(C) = RM.l(C);                     RE.fx(C) = RE.l(C);
RA.fx(A) = RA.l(A);
* Nests of value added (17.2) exist only where an activity uses them
QNA.fx(NST, A)$(not NNA(NST, A)) = 0;   PNA.fx(NST, A)$(not NNA(NST, A)) = 0;
* Output by activity (17.3) exists only for the commodities aggregated
PXAC.fx(A, C)$(not XAC(A, C)) = 0;      QXAC.fx(A, C)$(not XAC(A, C)) = 0;

* Closure
GADJ.fx = GADJ.l;
if (clext = 1, FSAV.fx = FSAV.l; else EXR.fx = EXR.l;);
* Government (12.1): the tax scaling factors are fixed except the instrument
if (clgov > 1, GSAV.fx = GSAV.l;);
if (clgov <> 2, TINSADJ.fx = TINSADJ.l;);
if (clgov <> 3, TQADJ.fx = TQADJ.l;);
if (clgov <> 4, TMADJ.fx = TMADJ.l;);
if (clgov <> 5, TVADJ.fx = TVADJ.l;);
if (clsi = 1, MPSADJ.fx = MPSADJ.l; else IADJ.fx = IADJ.l;);
if (clnum = 1, CPI.fx = CPI.l; else DPI.fx = DPI.l;);
QFS.fx(F)$(fclo(F) = 1) = QFS.l(F);
WFDIST.fx(F, A)$(fclo(F) = 1 or fclo(F) >= 3) = WFDIST.l(F, A);
W.fx(F)$(fclo(F) = 2 or fclo(F) = 3) = W.l(F);
QF.fx(F, A)$(fclo(F) = 2) = QF.l(F, A);
* 14: the regime's slack is fixed
LSW.fx(F)$(fclo(F) = 4) = LSW.l(F);
LSM.fx(F)$(fclo(F) = 5) = LSM.l(F);
@@@ cge_write.gms
* cge_write.gms -- write the solution: scenario, variable, element1, element2, value
* $batinclude cge_write.gms <put file> <scenario name>
%1.pc = 5;
* numbers below .nz would be written as zero (default 1e-5)
%1.nz = 0;
%1.nd = 15;
%1.nr = 2;
%1.nw = 24;
put %1;
put 'scenario', 'variable', 'element1', 'element2', 'value' /;
put '%2', '__status__', '', '', mstat /;
loop(A, put '%2', 'PA', A.tl, '', PA.l(A) /;  put '%2', 'PVA', A.tl, '', PVA.l(A) /;
        put '%2', 'PINTA', A.tl, '', PINTA.l(A) /;  put '%2', 'QA', A.tl, '', QA.l(A) /;
        put '%2', 'QVA', A.tl, '', QVA.l(A) /;  put '%2', 'QINTA', A.tl, '', QINTA.l(A) /;
        put '%2', 'RA', A.tl, '', RA.l(A) /);
loop(C, put '%2', 'PX', C.tl, '', PX.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'PD', C.tl, '', PD.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'PE', C.tl, '', PE.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'PM', C.tl, '', PM.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'PQ', C.tl, '', PQ.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'QX', C.tl, '', QX.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'QD', C.tl, '', QD.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'QE', C.tl, '', QE.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'QM', C.tl, '', QM.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'QQ', C.tl, '', QQ.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'QG', C.tl, '', QG.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'QINV', C.tl, '', QINV.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'QT', C.tl, '', QT.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'QER', C.tl, '', QER.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'QSHI', C.tl, '', QSHI.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'PWE', C.tl, '', PWEV.l(C) /;
        put '%2', 'RM', C.tl, '', RM.l(C) /;  put '%2', 'RE', C.tl, '', RE.l(C) /);
loop((A, H), put '%2', 'QHA', A.tl, H.tl, QHA.l(A, H) /);
loop((A, C), put '%2', 'PXAC', A.tl, C.tl, PXAC.l(A, C) /;  put '%2', 'QXAC', A.tl, C.tl, QXAC.l(A, C) /);
loop(F, put '%2', 'W', F.tl, '', W.l(F) /;  put '%2', 'QFS', F.tl, '', QFS.l(F) /;
        put '%2', 'YF', F.tl, '', YF.l(F) /;  put '%2', 'EFF', F.tl, '', EFF.l(F) /;
        put '%2', 'LSW', F.tl, '', LSW.l(F) /;  put '%2', 'LSM', F.tl, '', LSM.l(F) /;
        put '%2', 'DW', F.tl, '', DW.l(F) /);
loop((F, A), put '%2', 'QF', F.tl, A.tl, QF.l(F, A) /;  put '%2', 'WFDIST', F.tl, A.tl, WFDIST.l(F, A) /);
loop((C, A), put '%2', 'QINT', C.tl, A.tl, QINT.l(C, A) /);
loop((NST, A), put '%2', 'QNA', NST.tl, A.tl, QNA.l(NST, A) /;  put '%2', 'PNA', NST.tl, A.tl, PNA.l(NST, A) /);
loop((C, H), put '%2', 'QH', C.tl, H.tl, QH.l(C, H) /);
loop((INS, F), put '%2', 'YIF', INS.tl, F.tl, YIF.l(INS, F) /);
loop(D, put '%2', 'YI', D.tl, '', YI.l(D) /;  put '%2', 'TINS', D.tl, '', TINS.l(D) /;
        put '%2', 'MPS', D.tl, '', MPS.l(D) /);
loop(H, put '%2', 'EH', H.tl, '', EH.l(H) /);
put '%2', 'EXR', '', '', EXR.l /;  put '%2', 'CPI', '', '', CPI.l /;  put '%2', 'DPI', '', '', DPI.l /;
put '%2', 'YG', '', '', YG.l /;  put '%2', 'EG', '', '', EG.l /;  put '%2', 'GSAV', '', '', GSAV.l /;
put '%2', 'FSAV', '', '', FSAV.l /;  put '%2', 'TINSADJ', '', '', TINSADJ.l /;
put '%2', 'MPSADJ', '', '', MPSADJ.l /;  put '%2', 'IADJ', '', '', IADJ.l /;
put '%2', 'GADJ', '', '', GADJ.l /;  put '%2', 'WALRAS', '', '', WALRAS.l /;
put '%2', 'YSHI', '', '', YSHI.l /;  put '%2', 'SHIADJ', '', '', SHIADJ.l /;  put '%2', 'HS', '', '', HS.l /;
put '%2', 'TQADJ', '', '', TQADJ.l /;  put '%2', 'TMADJ', '', '', TMADJ.l /;  put '%2', 'TVADJ', '', '', TVADJ.l /;
* user variables (from version 0.6.1), when the model has them
$if exist cge_user_write.inc $batinclude cge_user_write.inc %1 %2
putclose %1;
@@@ cge_solve.gms
* cge_solve.gms -- solve the model with the chosen solver (from version 0.4.3)
* $batinclude cge_solve.gms <model for --cgetype=mcp>
* --cgetype=cns (the default): a constrained nonlinear system, for PATH,
* CONOPT or KNITRO; --cgetype=nlp: the same equations with a constant
* objective, for NLP solvers such as CONOPT or IPOPT; --cgetype=mcp (from
* version 0.4.4): a mixed complementarity problem, for PATH, the model named
* as the argument (cgebase for the base, cgecon for a scenario with
* constraints). mstat keeps the model status, which cge_write.gms writes.
$ifthen.cgetype %cgetype% == nlp
option nlp = %cgesolver%;
solve cgenlp using nlp minimizing OBJ;
mstat = cgenlp.modelstat;
$elseif.cgetype %cgetype% == mcp
option mcp = %cgesolver%;
solve %1 using mcp;
mstat = %1.modelstat;
$else.cgetype
option cns = %cgesolver%;
solve cge using cns;
mstat = cge.modelstat;
$endif.cgetype
